once-ending-full-circle.semanticDescription: A weary medieval traveler returns at sunset to the same familiar village well and little cottage from which a worn looping road leads away and back. Their dusty pack and warm recognition make a journey coming full circle clear.

once-ending-beyond-the-palace.semanticDescription: A smiling pair of former palace residents walk away from a grand castle into a sunny modest countryside cottage garden, expensive cloaks folded away, visibly happy with simple freedom outside the palace.

once-ending-silent-bells.semanticDescription: A peaceful medieval town square at sunrise, villagers relaxed and unarmed, a prominently visible old bell tower above them with still silent bells and bell ropes removed. Tranquility after strife, no ringing movement.

once-ending-buried-secret.semanticDescription: A medieval traveler finishes burying a small locked secret chest beneath the roots of a freshly planted sapling; earth and spade foreground, the chest almost covered, young tree centered in hopeful light.

once-ending-waiting-light.semanticDescription: A single warmly glowing oil lamp waits on the sill of a cottage window every night, a quiet figure patiently looking out at an empty moonlit road, luminous light as the emotional center.

once-ending-hollow-victory.semanticDescription: An armored victorious ruler sits alone in a vast empty hall, a won trophy and crown resting beside them, slumped shoulders and unsatisfied wistful face despite the treasures. Victory without fulfillment.

once-ending-quiet-mirror.semanticDescription: An ornate enchanted mirror now completely plain and silent sits neglected on a medieval room wall; villagers happily talk and decide among themselves around a nearby table, ignoring the mirror.

once-ending-borrowed-magic.semanticDescription: Golden and emerald enchanted lights visibly flow out of an empty traveler's wand and satchel back into ancient forest trees, illuminating roots and leaves; the traveler peacefully releases borrowed magic.

once-ending-last-laugh.semanticDescription: A colorful medieval jester gently laughs with a relieved king and villagers, offering a friendly hand rather than mockery; warm communal joyful laughter in a castle courtyard, fool central.

once-ending-unfinished-map.semanticDescription: Two hopeful travelers drop their old map into a small campfire then step toward a sunlit untrodden path together, hands linked, no readable markings on burning parchment; free choice of a new direction.

once-ending-passing-seasons.semanticDescription: A once mournful traveler rests under a tree that has fresh spring blossoms amid fallen autumn leaves and melting last snow; softened hopeful expression, gentle cycle of seasons in one natural scene, no split panels.

once-ending-locked-door.semanticDescription: A massive ancient castle door permanently sealed with an iron lock and growing vines, while cheerful medieval villagers work and children play outside in bright daylight; barred threshold left behind, ordinary life flourishing.

once-ending-new-song.semanticDescription: A gentle medieval bard sings and plays a lute to smiling villagers and children in a cottage courtyard, their shared story turned into a warm joyful song; no musical notes, writing or text.

once-ending-different-names.semanticDescription: Two old friends joyfully recognize each other again after many years, both changed in appearance and simple medieval clothing, touching hands beside a village bridge, discarded old disguise masks at their feet suggest transformed identities; reunion central.

once-ending-simple-supper.semanticDescription: A warmly smiling family and traveler share humble bread and soup around a cottage table, close affection and candlelight central; an overflowing treasure chest stands unopened and unimportant in the shadows.

once-ending-gentle-ruler.semanticDescription: A crowned medieval ruler respectfully kneels to listen to an ordinary villager, relaxed open palms requesting help instead of raised command, kind attentive face and surprised but comfortable villager in royal courtyard.

once-ending-vanished-footprints.semanticDescription: Close foreground of a few mysterious three-toed creature footprints in fresh morning frost leading away from an empty cottage garden, soft dawn light; no creature or people remaining, only the curious tracks.

once-ending-unasked-question.semanticDescription: Contented medieval friends share a peaceful picnic, leaving an enigmatic closed sealed box untouched nearby; nobody inspects it, smiles and satisfied calm show they are happy without solving the remaining mystery.

once-ending-broken-spell.semanticDescription: A medieval traveler waves a heartfelt farewell to a departing loved one; shimmering magical chains around them visibly shatter into harmless golden sparks as the goodbye is spoken, freeing the traveler.

once-ending-earned-rest.semanticDescription: Two exhausted medieval travelers have finally fallen asleep comfortably by a warm cottage hearth beneath recognizable worn wooden roof beams, muddy boots and travel packs set aside, safe familiar rest.

once-ending-better-bargain.semanticDescription: Two medieval merchants smile in pleasant surprise after a fair exchange, each carrying an unexpectedly generous basket of goods and an extra small gift, hands parting after friendly bargain, market setting.

once-ending-forgotten-name.semanticDescription: A thriving medieval village market flourishes around an overlooked weathered statue of a once heroic traveler, ivy and dust covering the plain unmarked plinth; townspeople happily pass without remembering the hero.

once-ending-shared-burden.semanticDescription: Two medieval companions carry a large travel bundle together on a shared wooden pole, one at each end; their relaxed smiling faces and easy stride show the once-heavy burden made light by mutual help.

once-ending-unlikely-home.semanticDescription: A once frightening dark stone castle now shelters a relaxed traveler by a glowing welcoming hearth, ominous exterior glimpsed through an arch contrasts with kind warmth, open home and safe smile inside.

once-ending-changed-wish.semanticDescription: An older fairy-tale traveler releases the last glowing wish-star from their hands toward a fresh sapling and a sunrise road, setting aside a broken old crown, peaceful hopeful readiness for a completely new beginning.

once-ending-quiet-monster.semanticDescription: A large gentle horned fairy-tale monster in simple clothes quietly tends vegetables beside its modest remote cottage beyond rolling green hills, peaceful expression, watering can, no frightening attack.

once-ending-second-chance.semanticDescription: Two former medieval enemies place their swords on the ground and clasp hands in sincere reconciliation; behind them a formerly thorn-covered forest path opens into golden light, clear forgiveness instead of revenge.

once-ending-invisible-gift.semanticDescription: Medieval villagers stand together with empty open hands, gently smiling and feeling a warm luminous breeze of kindness around them; no visible physical gift or object, a shared sensation shown through relieved faces and subtle light.

once-ending-watchful-moon.semanticDescription: Two quiet fairy-tale companions whisper their shared secret beside a remote moonlit lake, the large watchful full moon reflected above and in still water, timeless secrecy, no written message or public witnesses.

once-ending-keeper-of-keys.semanticDescription: An elderly medieval gatekeeper gratefully gives a heavy ring of iron keys to a younger successor, then steps away freely through an open gate toward a bright road, relieved unburdened face, key handover central.

once-ending-strange-peace.semanticDescription: Medieval travelers calmly sit in peaceful companionship beside a mysterious gentle floating luminous creature of unfamiliar form in a forest clearing, weapons set aside, curiosity and acceptance rather than fear or explanation.

once-ending-last-candle.semanticDescription: A guardian quietly extinguishes the final candle in a safe cottage room; thin smoke rises from the dark wick, all family members asleep peacefully together behind it, dawn light providing reassurance.

once-ending-new-beginning.semanticDescription: An old medieval storyteller hands an open unlettered storybook and travel staff to a young new adventurer who steps eagerly onto a sunlit winding road, passing the tale to the next person, hopeful new adventure.
